build_command: cargo build -p quench-node -p quench-test262 --bin quench-node-next --bin run-stages-next
representation: The entry projects .mjs to the existing SourceKind::Module. OXC and the shared VM own parsing, module semantics, Promise jobs and evaluation. The Runtime pending query projects the existing ModuleRecord.outcome; it adds no state, cache, opcode, heap cell or executor. The Node entry owns the named unsettled-top-level-await exit status 13.

oracle.scope: Settled/rejected/unsettled top-level await, module strict this, exports, CJS await rejection, ordinary CJS parse goal, and the unchanged tracked TLA fixture. Error controls compare exit/stdout and rejection reason, not full diagnostic rendering. Scratch Node controls explicitly disable warnings; the tracked case uses an ordinary Node file invocation.
oracle.diagnostic_limits: Node emits a pending-TLA warning by default and formats exception stacks differently. The development entry diagnostic policy and full Node host observations remain unqualified.

test262.scope: language/module-code, module execution and Promise-job callers

internal.obligation: Absent evaluation fails closed, pending evaluation survives GC/jobs, and reinitialization releases old module records without leaking completion into another source unit. Replaces an ordinary module compilation smoke unit; no duplicate conformance unit is added.

limits: Node host APIs, module resolution/package type selection, CJS wrapping and event-loop migration remain open
Implemented inventory is not frozen and Stage A remains open
No full conformance suite or performance campaign run
Wasm execution/lowering/storage and the residual ABI are unchanged; no Wasm scope is affected by this host query
